dogecoin.text: The meme and the joke have made for so much marketing and popularity, that it will be difficult for many of these new cryptos to equal doge... this is why #dogecoin has surpassed any other financial asset’s increase in price YTD.

Meme, joke and all, why is #dogecoin the king of crypto? Because of its user base, and because I can use and change my doges for real things instantly: just like money... most people accept #doge  as a payment method, because so many people already have them 🐕...

Instead, #dogecoin can be transferred wallet to wallet in seconds, and it’s very easy for the human mind to understand that the same can of soda costs 2 doges. This makes it usable for everyday life. Add a strong #blockchain technology, a limited # of coins, and a huge user base.
